text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B in several profitable trades felt rewarding, but I should judge future sales by my target allocation and investment plan, not the satisfaction of realizing a gain.","After selling Stock C at a gain, I should avoid treating my purchase price or unrealized profit as a reason by itself to hold or sell; evaluate each position consistently.","The portfolio declined for several periods before recovering, reinforcing that short-term moves are unpredictable. I should maintain diversification and avoid reactive trading based on recent performance."]}
